raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions applies a hard-coded 26-hour lateness cutoff, so legitimate late-arriving POSTED transactions are silently dropped from silver and gold. Batches 11–14 carry transactions about 3 days old, and roughly 70–90 rows per batch are lost. The txn_ids are all distinct and the daily totals (~330 POSTED/day, about 267 on time plus ~70 late) fit genuine late arrivals rather than duplicates, so they should be kept; the 2026-01-17 volume spike looks like a real busy day.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
